title: Mobility, Traps, Nonlethal, Weapon & Martial Edge Systems
objective: Close retained mobility/freerunning, traps, nonlethal-combat, weapon-proficiency and martial-style edge-system concepts against their exact shared engines/owners without creating standalone duplicate systems or inventing source mechanics.
closure_summary: Mobility/freerunning reuses MAL/F013/A7/CAB seams; deployable traps retain Item content identity while runtime composes MAL/F013/A7; nonlethal resolution remains an A7/CAB outcome path; weapon proficiency and martial advancement remain CAB-owned with legacy martial content repair routed through CAB-22. No standalone edge subsystem or new owner-decision queue was created.
selection_boundaries: SGC-05A closes only mobility, traps, nonlethal, weapon-proficiency and martial-style edge systems.
Persistent hazards, rest/exhaustion, specialist medicine, constructs, expeditions and source holds remain SGC-05B scope.
All SGC-03/04 unresolved decisions remain routed to SGC-07A and were not reopened.
Historical audit-corpus material was not used as current authority.
next_action: SGC-05A is completed_verified. SGC-05B is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
